raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The 2026-01-17 change (DE-412) added `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 HOUR` to silver_transactions. From batch 3 onward many valid POSTED transactions arrive about 3 days after txn_ts, so this filter silently drops them. The remaining gap is the intended REVERSED exclusion. The fix is to remove the stale filter and keep the POSTED filter.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.62,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
